messages:
noah: Heads-up — we're planning a small change to the generation endpoint: rename query/body param `model` -> `model_id` and switch the unpinned default to `open-lite-3` for hosted. Planning to roll next Tue. Any immediate compatibility concerns?

maya-p: Hosted only or does Dedicated/Private get the default change too? timeline?

noah: Default switch will be hosted and Dedicated-managed defaults (customers can still pin their model explicitly). Private deployments won't auto-change. Roll window: next Tue -> canary -> gradual.

jgonzalez: Gateway/compat note: we should accept `model` for a deprecation window and map to `model_id` server-side. Also add `Accept-Version` negotiation so clients can opt into the new param semantics. Quick pseudo: 

```lua
-- request shim pseudo
local m = ngx.req.get_post_args().model_id or ngx.req.get_post_args().model
if m then ngx.req.set_post_arg('model_id', m) end
```

And return a `Deprecation-Warning` header when `model` is used.

samir: SDK impact: treat this as non-breaking if we do the shim + header, but we should bump the client SDK minor version and emit a runtime warning when `model` is provided. Add unit tests for both param names. Also flag any languages that serialize differently (e.g., python kwargs vs JS object).

liz-c: Docs action: write a deprecation page and a migration snippet like `client.generate({model: \"x\"}) -> client.generate({model_id: \"x\"})`. Recommend 90-day acceptance window for the old param and then drop. Also add a note in "breaking changes" page for the default model change. I'll draft PR.

carol-s: QA checklist idea: 1) integration tests hitting hosted with old param, 2) e2e of default fallback for unpinned requests, 3) Dedicated smoke with pinned config, 4) SDK CI runs with pinned and unpinned requests. I'll own the test plan.

jgonzalez: Response header example we should return when `model` is used: `Deprecation-Warning: \"'model' parameter deprecated; use 'model_id' (accepted until 2026-07-01)\"` and `X-Redwood-Deprecation: model:2026-07-01`. Also ensure router logs include `compat_shim=1` for telemetry.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary window starting 1715006000 -> us-west-2, 10% traffic for 2h. Alert rule: error-rate >= 0.5% for 15m -> rollback.

integrations-bot: Filed SDK issues: https://internal/repo/issues/4321 (JS), /4322 (PY), /4323 (GO). Will attach migration snippets and test cases.

noah: Action items: 1) gateway shim + header (jgonzalez), 2) SDK warning + minor bump + tests (samir + integrations-bot followups), 3) docs + deprecation page (liz-c), 4) QA test plan (carol-s), 5) comms + support templates (maya-p). I'll sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm readiness.

maya-p: :thumbsup: if anyone hits blockers ping me here or DM and we'll pause rollout. Thanks y'all.
